messages.snippet: Eleanor, Please find attached the first draft of the Share Purchase Agreement. Key commercial points
messages.subject: Project Quartz - SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Please find attached the first draft of the Share Purchase Agreement. Key commercial points are as per the Heads: £38.75m equity value (cash-free/debt-free, completion-accounts adjustment), 12-month retention, deferred consideration, and recourse principally to a buy-side W&I policy. You'll see the warranty package and tax covenant in the schedules.

We've pitched the Sellers' liability cap at 20% of consideration to open; I expect we'll land lower. Look forward to your mark-up.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
